newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bonds rise on U.S., further rises doubtful.
newsitem.headline: Danish bonds rise on U.S., further rises doubtful.

text.p: Danish bond prices opened higher on Monday buoyed by solid advances on Wall Street on Friday but dealers were doubtful about further rises.

"I am a little sceptical about the possibility of further rises. I want to see others buy before I do, the Central Bank will doubtless enter the market to sell at the new higher levels," one dealer said.
The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was up 0.18 point from Friday's close at 110.28. The 10-year yield gap with Germany narrowed one basis point to 66.
The crown stood at 3.8082 per mark at 0735 gmt, weakening from 3.8070 on Friday afternoon.
